name: HoverCard
summary: A read only preview card for a link or a person, shown on hover and on keyboard focus of the link. The link works on its own; the card only saves a click.
useWhen: A preview of a person behind a name link (avatar, role, a line of bio)
A preview of a page, a file or a board behind a link in running text
Extra context that sighted pointer users like to peek at, and that the link target also shows
avoidWhen: Content with actions or fields a person must use
The only place some information or a link is reachable
A one line hint for a control
Touch first screens, where nothing hovers

size.description: The width: sm 240 (tooltip.width.max), md 320 px (menu.width.min times 1.6).

openDelay.description: Open delay on hover in ms. Focus opens at once.

closeDelay.description: Close delay in ms after the pointer leaves the link and the card.

side.description: HoverCardContent: the preferred side. start and end follow the reading direction. It flips when there is no room.

align.description: HoverCardContent: alignment along the link, mirrored in right to left layouts.

hideWhenDetached.description: HoverCardContent: hides the card while its link is out of view or hidden.

HoverCardTrigger.description: One child element, a link that works on its own (always asChild). Hover and focus open the card.

a11y.role: No role: a visual preview next to the link. The trigger gets no aria-describedby; the card is not announced and takes no focus.
a11y.focus: Never takes focus. Keyboard focus on the link opens the card; focus stays on the link. Links inside the card are taken out of the tab order (tabindex -1).

keys.Escape: Hides the card; focus stays on the link

a11y.announce: Nothing: the card is a visual preview. Screen reader users follow the link to the full page.
notes: The card is never the only way to reach its content or its links: the link target shows the same and more.
WCAG 1.4.13: hoverable (the pointer can move onto the card), dismissable with Escape, persistent until the pointer leaves both or focus leaves the link.
The root carries data-side and data-align from Radix; data-side is physical after the logical side prop is mapped by direction.
The gallery demo sets openDelay 0 so the contract suite and screenshots open a card with one hover; products keep the 500 ms default.
A card short of room scrolls inside, and the keyboard cannot scroll it (the card takes no focus). That is acceptable only because the link target repeats the content; keep cards short.
Order 1.23 motion: the card unfolds out of its trigger side, more along the axis away from the trigger (--_hover-card-enter-stretch) than across it.

en.body: Short facts in sentence case: the name and handle, one line of bio, one line of meta. An empty field says so: No bio yet.

ar.body: Short facts, no diacritics, Western digits: سارة أحمد، 12 لوحة.

react.note: Shares the themed portal and side mapping of Popover (FloatingLayer.tsx).

native.note: Nothing hovers on touch screens: the link opens the page directly.

styles.studio: The Popover surface: color.bg.surface, the default border, the panel radius and the menu shadow, with the arrow. Grows from 97% out of the link side.
styles.desk: Glass: the strong glass fill, the glass border, the window blur and the soft window shadow (recipe).

mistakes.wrong: A Follow button inside the hover card
mistakes.right: A Popover, or the button on the profile page

mistakes.wrong: A hover card on a span that does not take focus
mistakes.right: A link as the trigger, so focus opens it too

mistakes.wrong: Facts that appear only in the hover card
mistakes.right: The same facts on the page the link opens
